I have always had problems sleeping for a very long time, only getting worse .
I have progressive MS, and after a double hernia operation on 24th July 2026, I went into rehab due to a mess up with doctors' physio treatment for my MS. The doctor there prescribed a couple of sleeping tablets (prescribed for short period) but has not worked . The NHS doctors don't have the time to treat patients properly. I am now out of rehab with no real solution to my sleeping problem

I have tried HC like this plus a Ganeshdeva mantra. Maybe my fate is not strong but needs help to be able to sleep at 5-6 hrs continuous .
Any suggestions

Check your vitamins specifically D3
